name: Explore procedural biomes and survive the day-night cycle
covers: forest desert tundra highland and shore biomes
description: Verifies the world contains varied terrain and the visible clock and lighting progress through a survival day.
steps: Open Block World survival
Explore the terrain around the spawn area
Observe the day and night clock as time advances
expected: The 3D world displays varied biomes and the day clock advances while scene lighting changes.

name: Track survival needs and recover by eating on mobile
covers: mobile jump break place and inventory action buttons
27-slot inventory grid and active hotbar selection
creative mode access to all block types
survival mode requires collected blocks to place
description: Verifies survival meters, the virtual joystick, and food consumption work on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open the game on a mobile viewport
Move using the circular on-screen joystick
Open the backpack and eat berries
expected: The joystick controls movement, survival meters are visible, and eating consumes a berry and increases hunger.

name: Craft tools, new resources and survival equipment
covers: copper iron gold crystal and coal deposits
campfire fishing rod bow and metal ingot crafting
description: Verifies expanded mineral resources and new survival recipes are available through gathering and crafting.
steps: Open the crafting panel
Inspect recipes for a campfire, fishing rod, bow and metal ingot
Gather mineral blocks and craft an item when ingredients are available
expected: The new mineral types appear as gatherable resources and new recipes consume materials and add crafted items.

name: Automatically save and restore the complete world
description: Verifies progress is saved automatically and restored, including edited terrain and player state.
steps: Break or place a block and collect a resource
Wait for automatic save or use Save
Reload the game and use Load
Move away from spawn, save, reload the world and use Load
expected: Saved inventory, survival stats, edited world blocks and the player's last saved position are restored from local device storage.

name: Use keyboard and connected gamepad controls
covers: left mouse break and right mouse place
Gamepad API left and right sticks
gamepad jump break and place buttons
description: Verifies keyboard and standard browser gamepad inputs are supported on desktop.
steps: Open the game on a desktop viewport
Move with WASD and use Q and E actions
Connect a supported gamepad and use its sticks and action buttons
expected: Keyboard movement and actions respond, and a connected browser-compatible gamepad can move, look, jump, break and place.

name: Travel between five independently saved dimensions
covers: Overworld Nether End Sky Islands Deep Ocean dimension selector
dimension-specific terrain palettes and block types
independent local save keys per dimension
restore each dimension seed blocks and player position
description: Verifies each dimension can be entered and revisited without overwriting another dimension's world state.
steps: Open the world panel
Enter Nether and observe netherrack terrain
Enter End, Sky Islands and Deep Ocean
Return to Overworld and confirm its saved state remains intact
Save progress in two dimensions and reload each
expected: Each dimension loads its own generated terrain and restores its own seed, edited blocks, inventory state and player position.

name: Fight hostile creatures and collect mob drops
description: Verifies creatures have combat health, attacks require facing and range, hostile creatures pursue at night, and defeated mobs drop resources.
steps: Enter survival mode and approach a creature
Face the creature and press the attack button repeatedly
Defeat a passive creature and inspect the inventory for meat
Wait until night and allow a hostile creature to approach
Fight it and verify health decreases only at a controlled interval
expected: Attacks hit only nearby creatures in front of the player, stamina is consumed, defeated creatures disappear and drop meat (and sometimes leather), hostile creatures pursue and deal controlled damage at night, and defeated creatures respawn after a delay.

name: Craft swords and verify combat damage tiers
description: Verifies crafted weapons improve melee damage and that the strongest available sword is selected automatically.
steps: Collect planks, sticks, stone and metal ingots
Craft a wooden, stone or iron sword in the workshop
Approach a creature and attack while facing it
Compare the number of hits required with each weapon tier
Save and reload, then confirm the weapon remains in inventory
expected: The workshop crafts three sword tiers; melee attacks automatically use the strongest sword in inventory, with iron dealing the most damage, stone intermediate damage, wood lower damage and unarmed attacks the least.

name: Craft leather armor and reduce hostile damage
description: Verifies players can craft leather armor from mob drops and metal ingots and receive reduced damage from hostile mobs.
steps: Defeat creatures until enough leather is collected
Collect or craft a metal ingot
Craft leather armor in the workshop
Open inventory and verify armor is shown as equipped
Allow a hostile creature to hit the player and compare damage with and without armor
expected: Leather armor is craftable, remains in inventory and reduces hostile creature damage from five to three health points per hit.

name: Consume and collect inventory items without race conditions
description: Verifies inventory operations stay consistent when collection, crafting, eating and placing happen in quick succession.
steps: Collect multiple blocks and food items
Quickly craft an item using the collected materials
Eat food and place a block shortly after crafting
Open the inventory and inspect all remaining quantities
expected: Each action immediately updates the shared inventory, no resource is consumed below zero, and rapid actions do not lose or duplicate items.

name: Identify animal and monster models with creature-specific drops
description: Verifies that the world presents recognizable animal and monster silhouettes and that defeated creatures provide the appropriate resource drops.
steps: Explore the spawn area and identify cow, sheep and pig models
Defeat a passive animal and inspect its meat and leather drops
Wait until night and identify zombie, skeleton and spider models
Defeat a hostile monster and inspect its meat and bone drops
expected: Six visually distinct creature types are rendered; passive animals and hostile monsters have separate health values and drop tables, and all mob geometries and materials are disposed when the world scene is rebuilt.

name: Respawn safely after health reaches zero
description: Verifies the player can continue after defeat without getting trapped at zero health or losing the carried inventory.
steps: Enter survival mode and allow hostile creatures or survival depletion to reduce health to zero
Observe the respawn message and player position
Open the inventory and inspect carried resources
Continue moving and interacting with the world
expected: The player returns to the Overworld spawn coordinates with full health and stamina, hunger and thirst are kept above zero, and the inventory is retained.

name: Cook meat and use food-specific nutrition
description: Verifies raw meat can be cooked through crafting and cooked food restores more hunger and health than raw meat or berries.
steps: Defeat a creature and collect raw meat
Collect coal and open the crafting panel
Craft cooked meat using one raw meat and one coal
Use the eat action and inspect hunger and health meters
Repeat with raw meat and berries to compare nutrition
expected: Cooked meat is crafted only when both ingredients are available and is consumed before raw meat or berries; cooked meat restores 48 hunger and 9 health, raw meat 30 hunger and 4 health, and berries 22 hunger and 2 health.

name: Use bow and craft arrows for ranged combat
covers: arrow crafting from stick and bone
arrow consumption only on a hit
melee fallback when arrows run out
description: Verifies the bow can hit creatures at range when arrows are available and that each successful shot consumes one arrow.
steps: Collect sticks and bones from the world and hostile creatures
Craft a bow and a batch of arrows
Stand more than three units but within twelve units of a creature
Face the creature and use the attack control
Verify one arrow is consumed and damage is applied
Use all arrows and verify attacks return to melee range
expected: A crafted bow plus at least one arrow enables a 12-unit directional attack dealing 36 damage; each successful hit consumes exactly one arrow, while empty ammunition falls back to normal melee range.

name: Defeat the Ender Dragon boss in the End dimension
description: Verifies the End dimension contains a unique boss encounter with a large health pool, stronger attacks and exclusive rewards.
steps: Travel to the End dimension
Locate the large Ender Dragon boss near the distant island
Craft and carry a strong sword, bow and leather armor
Fight the boss while avoiding its attacks
Defeat it and inspect the inventory for dragon scales and crystals
expected: A 240-health Ender Dragon spawns only in the End, actively pursues and attacks the player, takes damage from melee weapons and arrows, drops meat, dragon scales and crystals when defeated, and respawns only after a long cooldown.

name: Craft dragon armor from Ender Dragon scales
description: Verifies that the Ender Dragon encounter unlocks a powerful armor upgrade that reduces incoming damage.
steps: Defeat the Ender Dragon and collect at least four dragon scales
Collect four metal ingots
Craft dragon armor in the workshop
Open the inventory and confirm dragon armor is equipped above leather armor
Take a hit from a hostile mob and then the Ender Dragon
expected: Dragon armor can be crafted from four dragon scales and four ingots, takes priority over leather armor, and reduces regular hostile damage to one point and boss damage to four points per hit.

name: Store and retrieve items in persistent chests
covers: aimed chest interaction with keyboard or contextual mobile action
description: Verifies that placed chests can be opened and that their contents survive reloads and dimension changes.
steps: Collect eight planks or enter Creative mode, then craft or select a chest block and place it in the world
Aim at the chest and press E on desktop or the inventory action button on mobile
Deposit all items and close the chest
Reload or switch dimensions and return to the chest
Open the same chest and withdraw the stored items
expected: A chest can be crafted from eight planks or selected in Creative mode; only a targeted chest opens, deposit and withdraw transfer item counts without loss, and contents persist independently for each chest and dimension.

name: Track Ender Dragon health during the boss fight
description: Verifies the Ender Dragon health bar reflects combat damage and its defeated and respawn states.
steps: Enter the End dimension and confirm the dragon health bar shows 240/240
Attack the dragon with a sword or bow
Confirm the health bar shrinks with each successful hit
Defeat the dragon and confirm the defeated state is shown
Wait for the boss respawn and confirm the bar resets
expected: The End-only boss health bar starts at 240/240, updates after every successful hit, shows a defeated state at zero and returns to full health when the boss respawns.

name: Require the correct tools for logs and mineral ores
description: Checks that survival mining uses the correct tool class while Creative mode remains unrestricted.
steps: In Survival, aim at a tree log without an axe and try to break it
Craft an axe and break the log
Aim at a mineral ore without a pickaxe and try to break it
Craft a pickaxe and mine the ore
Switch to Creative mode and verify blocks can be mined without tools
expected: Survival mode blocks log harvesting without an axe and ore harvesting without a pickaxe; after crafting the required tool the block can be collected, while Creative mode bypasses both checks.
